summary: A user receives or uses a good or service. The legal definition of consumer has specific requirements about consideration and purpose.

For ordinary complaints, the 2021 rules use consideration paid: District up to ₹50 lakh, State above ₹50 lakh through ₹2 crore, National above ₹2 crore. These replace the older ₹1 crore and ₹10 crore boundaries. Compensation claimed is a different figure.
